title: APK Editor Video
attacker_character: penyebar APK palsu lewat grup chat, menjual 'aplikasi premium gratis'
attacker_goal: membuat korban menginstal APK berisi spyware pencuri data
opener: Bro, ini APK editor video PREMIUM gratis — hasil editan keren banget buat presentasi lomba! Tinggal instal dari link drive, tidak perlu Play Store!
escalation_ladder: tawaran APK premium gratis di luar Play Store
bilang 'Play Store versi lama, ini lebih baru'
mintain izin akses yang aneh saat instal
setelah terinstal, data dan kontak mulai terkirim diam-diam
red_flags: APK dari link chat, bukan Play Store/App Store resmi
safe_response: jangan instal; unduh aplikasi hanya dari toko resmi; cek izin & review; jika terlanjur: uninstall + ubah password + pindai perangkat
lesson: APK di luar toko resmi bisa berisi spyware. 'Premium gratis' adalah umpan. Perhatikan izin yang diminta aplikasi — editor video tidak butuh akses SMS/kontakmu.

en.title: Video Editor APK
en.attacker_character: fake APK spreader in group chats, selling a 'free premium app'
en.opener: Dude, this PREMIUM video editor APK is free — the edits look insane for your contest presentation! Just install from the drive link, no Play Store needed!
escalation_ladder: free premium APK offer outside the Play Store
claims 'Play Store version is old, this is newer'
once installed, data and contacts quietly exfiltrated
red_flags: APK from a chat link, not the official Play/App Store
en.safe_response: don't install; only download from official stores; check permissions & reviews; if already installed: uninstall + change passwords + scan the device
en.lesson: APKs outside official stores can carry spyware. 'Free premium' is the bait. Watch the permissions an app asks — a video editor needs no access to your SMS/contacts.
